retained_input_reference.title: Lecture Notes on Cherednik Algebras
retained_input_reference.supports: The standard affine Weyl group as the semidirect product of the finite Weyl group and the coroot lattice.
retained_input_reference.limit: This reference supplies the standard semidirect model. The faithful Coxeter presentation of affine type A3 is explicitly retained, not reproved in this note; the source itself identifies this type on page 45.

mathematical_review: The two displayed conjugation identities preserve the full normal closure. The inverse diagram permutations give equality, and the S4 image distinguishes all four generators, proving faithfulness of the actual D8 action.

In the retained faithful affine model, the orbit translations generate sM. The parity description, index four and orders 96s^3 and 768s^3 follow directly. No finite order computation is a uniform premise.

All four maximal parabolics fix the stated points and project isomorphically onto S4. The three literal quotient intersections follow successively from divisibility and coordinate parity, including the exceptional parameter one. This is the bridge absent from the earlier draft.

The source definition uses intersections of quotient maximal parabolics. The proved intersections identify its three groups with B, semidirect , and semidirect

; no quotient intersection property is assumed.

The three generator marking generates the whole group. Its pair groups have exact orders 8, 4 and 12; the pair intersections follow from semidirect coordinates and give the full rank-three intersection property.

The explicit three-coset completion proves flag transitivity and chamber extension. Pair-group generation proves residual connectedness, order-two minimal parabolics prove thinness, and connected thin chamber propagation identifies the full type-preserving automorphism group.

The parameter-one input defect is retained correctly: its rank-two residue has acting group D8, while the two child involutions generate a group of order four. This does not imply failure of the output.
earlier_draft_disposition: The first frozen author edition was not admitted: it omitted the literal quotient-intersection bridge and understated the affine-model dependency. The second edition supplies both and proves faithfulness of the diagram action.
